# Prismic

Prismic is a headless CMS that enables developers and content teams to manage and deliver content seamlessly across various platforms.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/prismic/.

## Actions

- **Content API: Get Documents with Integration Fields** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents including integration fields data.
- **Get Ordered Documents** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents ordered by a specified field.
- **Get Prismic Document by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific prismic document by its id.
- **Get Prismic Documents by Tag** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents by tag.
- **Get Prismic Documents by Type** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents by type.
- **Get Prismic Documents with Fulltext Search** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents using a full-text search predicate.
- **Get Prismic Documents with Predicates** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents using specified predicates.
- **Get Prismic Repository Info** (read-only): Retrieve prismic repository metadata.
- **Get Prismic Repository Refs** (read-only): Retrieve a list of repository refs (master and releases).
- **Prismic: Get Documents by Custom Field** (read-only): Fetch prismic documents by custom field predicate.
- **Prismic: Query Documents** (read-only): Query prismic documents using predicates and pagination.
- **Get Prismic Tags** (read-only): Retrieve all tags from prismic repository.
- **Prismic: Get Custom Types** (read-only): Retrieve all custom types and slices from the prismic repository.
